entries.assessment_basis: Direct comparison against the authoritative 27 July 2026 consolidated EUR-Lex text demonstrated material article-level compression. Articles 10 and 13 have now been re-extracted into a 32-record semantic-atomicity migration candidate, replacing two coarse article-level abstractions; the remainder of the represented Act scope still requires the same review.
known_fidelity_gaps: The canonical requirements.json still contains the two coarse Article 10 and Article 13 identities until the staged migration is applied and the full corpus validators pass.
Article 4a is materially cross-referenced by the amended Article 10(1) and remains a separate re-extraction target because its current article-level abstraction compresses conditions and safeguards.
Other operator-facing article-level records require the same semantic-atomicity review before clause-level fidelity can be asserted.
entries.next_action: Apply the staged Articles 10 and 13 migration, then continue re-extraction through Article 4a and the remaining operator-facing provisions before specialist legal assurance and any fidelity-assured claim.
